name: SWEEP-S2v2 Expensive minds
_design: v2 fix after S2v1 (all 8 starved by r45, 0 skills, 0 thoughts even mentioning skills or thinking cost; 87% of spend was thinking at 13.6/decision, 49% of actions were single-cell observes). World-only changes: (1) thinking about 8 per decision (input 0.0006, output 0.006, was 0.001/0.01) so agents live ~24 decisions instead of ~14; (2) skill action discount 0.5 (was 0.8), so every price line reads 'move 5 (skill 2.5)'; (3) mature trees fruit every 3 rounds (energy inflow 20, was every 5 with 12), so the start tree visibly refruits and 'check here, absorb, repeat' is the obvious routine. A deliberate-every-round agent at its own tree breaks even; one that thinks less prospers. Paired with S3v2 (identical except thinking is free).
